property_definitions.conditions: CCD reference component, unmodified standard residue.
property_definitions.label: Side-chain heavy-atom count
property_definitions.limitations: Atom count is not steric volume, accessibility, or measured packing.
property_definitions.method: Count CCD non-backbone, non-leaving atoms other than H.

property_definitions.conditions: CCD reference component, unmodified standard residue.
property_definitions.label: Side-chain aromatic-atom count
property_definitions.limitations: Aromatic atoms do not establish a pi interaction in a protein.
property_definitions.method: Count side-chain heavy atoms with the CCD aromatic flag.

property_definitions.conditions: CCD reference component, unmodified standard residue.
property_definitions.label: Side-chain N/O/S atom count
property_definitions.limitations: Heteroatom count is not a hydrogen-bond donor/acceptor count.
property_definitions.method: Count side-chain heavy atoms whose element is N, O, or S.

property_definitions.conditions: CCD reference component, unmodified standard residue.
property_definitions.label: Non-carboxyl side-chain hydroxyl count
property_definitions.limitations: Reference O-H groups do not establish protonation or hydrogen bonds in a protein.
property_definitions.method: Count side-chain O bonded to H and C, excluding carboxyl O; includes phenol.

property_definitions.conditions: CCD reference component, unmodified standard residue.
property_definitions.label: Side chain closes onto backbone nitrogen
property_definitions.limitations: Reference connectivity does not establish a conformation or folding outcome.
property_definitions.method: One if a side-chain heavy atom is directly bonded to backbone N; otherwise zero.

property_definitions.conditions: Original empirical scale; not a site-specific free energy.
property_definitions.label: Kyte-Doolittle residue hydropathy
property_definitions.limitations: Larger is more hydrophobic on this scale; no categorical cutoff or solubility inference.
property_definitions.method: Original KYTJ820101 values transcribed from Biopython 1.85 ProtParamData.kd.

property_definitions.conditions: Independent-site sequence model; excludes terminal groups.
property_definitions.label: Reference side-chain pKa parameter
property_definitions.limitations: Not an experimentally measured pKa at a particular protein site; omits environmental shifts.
property_definitions.method: Bjellqvist side-chain tables as implemented in Biopython 1.85 IsoelectricPoint.

property_definitions.conditions: pH 7; independent side-chain model, no terminal groups, ligands or PTMs.
property_definitions.label: Modeled side-chain charge at pH 7
property_definitions.limitations: No titratable group in this model gives zero; this is not observed site charge or assay pH.

checks: All 22 source files pass exact membership, URL/license, byte-count and SHA-256 checks.
CCD one-letter/component identities and peptide-linking types match all 20 MOD/ChEBI mappings.
All 20 side-chain heavy-atom counts inspected; backbone, leaving atoms and hydrogen excluded.
Aromatic atom sets inspected for F/H/W/Y; hydroxyl groups for S/T/Y exclude carboxyl O-H.
Amide N/Q, guanidino R, primary amino K, thiol C, thioether M and proline ring closure inspected.
Initial amide/guanidino/lysine classification defect reproduced with failing tests and corrected.
Kyte-Doolittle and Bjellqvist literal source tables agree with independently maintained biophysical constants.
pH-7 side-chain charge uses the explicit independent-site model; no terminal or environment contribution.
review.limitations: Machine-assisted self-review, not independent human scientific approval. Chemical-component reference flags do not establish physiological protonation, local hydrogen bonds, steric volume, conformational effects or variant outcomes. pKa values are model parameters, not site measurements. Existing SEEDED trait records are not promoted by this review. Modified/nonstandard residues are excluded.
review.scope: All 20 standard residue identities, their existing MOD/ChEBI links, CCD atom/bond projections, functional-group rules and eight operational properties. Exact raw snapshot chemistry-2026-10-08; not an assessment of any protein mechanism.

scope: Unmodified standard peptide-residue reference chemistry only. CCD atom/bond flags are a chemical reference, not coordinates, physiological protonation, or a protein interaction. Properties do not establish binding, catalysis, trafficking, transport or variant effects. Modified, ambiguous and nonstandard residues require separate evidence; do not substitute parents.

evidence.notes: Checked source identity; atom/bond rows or the named literal parameter table support the projection.
evidence.snippet: Calculate isoelectric points of polypeptides using methods of Bjellqvist.
